steps.title: Login screen — initial state
steps.notes: Assertion-only step confirming the initial login screen state, per flow/userLogin.md Step 1.

steps.title: Continue with password — password screen
steps.notes: Phone-number EditText has no content-desc/text of its own (per loginFlow.plan.json step 3), so the '+91' country-code badge is used as the tap selector to focus it before typing, matching the previously-verified loginFlow pattern. Entering the number before tapping 'Continue with password' is what pre-fills the phone-number field shown on the resulting password screen. settleMs added after the +91 tap: verified live that typing immediately after focusing this Compose field drops the first character, producing a 9-digit number that still reaches the password screen and passes every assertion while logging in as the wrong user.

steps.title: Successful login — Home page
steps.notes: Types directly into the password field already present on this screen. The previous back + re-tap of "Continue with password" was copied from loginFlow, where it exists only to clear a deliberately-wrong password; userLogin never types one, and verified live that back does NOT leave the password screen on this build, so the re-tap could never resolve. Field selected via its password="true" attribute, which is unique here (the only other EditText is the pre-filled phone number).
